map.由带轮直径与转速求带速。: Find the belt speed from the pulley diameter and rotation speed.
map.📖 查看「同步带线速度计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Timing Belt Linear Speed Calculator"
map.同步带线速度 v = π × D × n ÷ 60，D 为带轮节圆直径（m）、n: Timing belt linear speed v = π x D x n / 60, where D is the pulley pitch diameter in metres and n the rotation speed in r/min; alternatively D = z x p / π from the tooth count z and the pitch p, which gives v = z x p x n / 60. It is used to check transmission ratios and validate timing belt selection.
map.轮径与转速换算。: Conversion between wheel diameter and rotation speed.
map.D=0.12 → v=1.885 m/s，线速与直径成正比。: D = 0.12 gives v = 1.885 m/s; the linear speed is proportional to the diameter.
map.D 取米、n 取 rpm，结果 m/s；也可直接 v=πDn（n 为 rps）。: Take D in metres and n in rpm to get m/s; you can also use v = πDn with n in rps.
map.同步带近似不打滑；平带需乘滑差系数。: A timing belt is essentially slip free, while a flat belt needs a slip factor applied.
